purpose: Outside lattice parameters used in Section 3.2 (R2 comment 2): the Materials Project PBE lattices the MLIPs' training data come from, and experimental cubic lattices. Values transcribed from the sources below on 2026-10-21; nothing here is computed in this repository.

materials_project_pbe.source: Materials Project public build bucket (s3://materialsproject-build), release 2025-09-25, materials collection, each material's entries.GGA.structure (PBE, VASP). The lattice shown on the MP website and OPTIMADE endpoint is the r2SCAN structure, not PBE.

knbo3_cubic.note: mp-7375 is R3m KNbO3, not cubic

batio3_cubic.source: M. Barzilay, H. Elangovan and Y. Ivry, ACS Appl. Electron. Mater. 1, 2431 (2019), doi:10.1021/acsaelm.9b00580, Fig. 2a caption (XRD)

srtio3_cubic.T_K: room temperature (not stated in the CIF)
srtio3_cubic.source: R. H. Mitchell, A. R. Chakhmouradian and P. M. Woodward, Phys. Chem. Miner. 27, 583 (2000), doi:10.1007/s002690000103, COD 9006864

knbo3_cubic.note: about 4.02 A above ~690 K is quoted only secondarily (Shirane et al. 1954 via arXiv cond-mat/9404083); no primary value seen, so not used

srtio3.source: D. de Ligny and P. Richet, Phys. Rev. B 53, 3013 (1996), doi:10.1103/PhysRevB.53.3013, abstract
srtio3.note: the abstract does not say volume or linear; read as a volume coefficient it is 1.08e-5 per K in lattice parameter, the lower of the two readings

pressure.source: G. A. Samara, Phys. Rev. 151, 378 (1966), doi:10.1103/PhysRev.151.378, abstract (-4.6 to -5.9 C/kbar)
